about: Retrieval eval for delphi-rag. Each question lists the (life, section) pairs that count as correct for corpus lives-v1; `evidence` is an exact quote from one of them, checked by tests/test_retrieval_eval.py. Questions written 2026-11-15 from the Gutenberg #674 text. `answer_life` (optional) names the Life the answer is about when `expected` also includes another Life's retelling; life@1 counts a top hit from answer_life or any expected section.

questions.question: Which of the Gracchi was beaten to death with clubs and pieces of benches?
questions.evidence: killed by clubs and staves only, none by an iron weapon

questions.question: Which brother was killed on the Capitol?
questions.evidence: killed by clubs and staves only
questions.note: Caius s19 also says this about Tiberius, so it counts as a hit; life@1 still wants Tiberius.

questions.question: Which Gracchus hid in a grove sacred to the Furies before he was killed?
questions.evidence: grove, consecrated to the Furies

questions.question: Which Gracchus had his fellow tribune Octavius deprived of his office?
questions.evidence: proposed to deprive Octavius of his tribuneship

questions.question: Which Gracchus passed a law to sell corn to the poor at a lower price?
questions.evidence: a fourth related to the price of corn

questions.question: Whose body was thrown into the river with the other corpses after he was killed?
questions.evidence: the other corpses, into the river
questions.note: Caius s19 also says this about Tiberius, so it counts as a hit; life@1 still wants Tiberius.

questions.question: What happened to Caius Gracchus's head after he was killed?
questions.evidence: when Caius's head was cut off

questions.question: Which Cato kept saying that Carthage ought to be destroyed?
questions.evidence: Carthage, methinks, ought utterly to be destroyed

questions.question: How did Cato die at Utica?
questions.evidence: stabbed it into his breast

questions.question: Which Cato read Plato's dialogue on the soul on the night he died?
questions.evidence: Plato's dialogue concerning the soul

questions.question: Which Cato studied with Antipater the Stoic?
questions.evidence: Antipater the Tyrian, the Stoic philosopher

questions.question: Which Cato sold his slaves when they grew old?
questions.evidence: selling them in their old age

questions.question: Which Cato's censorship pleased the people so much that they set up a statue to him?
questions.evidence: liked his censorship wondrously well

questions.question: How did Crassus defeat Spartacus?
questions.evidence: Of twelve thousand three hundred whom he killed

questions.question: What did Surena do with the head and hand of Crassus?
questions.evidence: Surena sent the head and hand of Crassus

questions.question: What did Caesar do when he reached the Rubicon?
questions.evidence: When he came to the river Rubicon

questions.question: How much ransom did the pirates first ask from Caesar?
questions.evidence: demanded of him twenty talents for his ransom

questions.question: How long did it take Pompey to clear the seas of pirates?
questions.evidence: in the space of three months

questions.question: Who struck Caesar first when he was assassinated?
questions.evidence: Casca gave him the first cut

questions.question: How did Crassus make his fortune?
questions.evidence: he got by fire and rapine

questions.question: What was done to Pompey's body in Egypt?
questions.evidence: cut off Pompey's head, and threw the rest of his body overboard

questions.question: Which young Roman, captured by sea raiders, laughed at the price they put on him?
questions.evidence: twenty talents for his ransom

questions.question: Why did a young tribune want public land returned to poor citizens?
questions.evidence: reinstate the poor citizens in their former possessions

questions.question: Which servant killed his master and then himself so the enemies would not take him alive?
questions.evidence: his servant Philocrates having first slain him

questions.question: Which general swept the raiders off the whole sea in a single season?
questions.evidence: in the space of three months

questions.question: Who chose to die rather than accept mercy from the man who won the civil war?
questions.evidence: stabbed it into his breast

questions.question: Which old statesman ended every speech by demanding that Rome's great rival city be wiped out?
questions.evidence: Carthage, methinks, ought utterly to be destroyed

questions.question: Whose mother bore the loss of both her sons with a noble spirit?
questions.evidence: bore the loss of her two sons with a noble and undaunted spirit

questions.question: Who made peace between the two most powerful men in Rome so that both would back him?
questions.evidence: reconciling of Crassus and Pompey

questions.question: What happened at the battle of Pharsalia?
questions.evidence: When the two armies were come into Pharsalia

questions.question: What did Pompey do when his army broke at Pharsalia?
questions.evidence: he went into his own tent, and sat down, speechless

questions.question: What did Caesar and Cato argue about in the senate during Catiline's conspiracy?
questions.evidence: Cato intimated in his speech the suspicion of Caesar himself

questions.question: Whose support won Caesar his first consulship?
questions.evidence: doubly supported by the interests of Crassus and Pompey
